title: Reference approach: Spatial Data Explorer
approach: Define the scientific question, inputs, units, output, and domain assumptions.
Separate loading, validation, calculation, and reporting into reusable functions.
Compare the selected SciPy method against a known result, residual, or independent approach.
Test normal, boundary, invalid, and non-finite inputs as applicable.
Record package versions, parameters, uncertainty, and known limitations.
acceptance_guidance: Query nearest neighbors with a spatial tree.
Build a convex hull or triangulation.
Demonstrate a graph operation and discuss scaling.
explanation: Reference design for Spatial Data Explorer. This file provides solution guidance rather than claiming a complete reviewed production implementation. All project data should be synthetic or properly licensed.
